name: Authenticated DAVImth chat and safe session handling
description: Verifies a returning account can exchange messages, copy a response and sign out without exposing the previous active chat.
steps: Sign in as the test account
Confirm the chat opens with no previous active messages
Send a clear question to DAVImth
Copy the assistant response
Sign out and sign in again
Confirm the new session starts with an empty conversation
expected: The assistant answers the question, its response can be copied, and signing in again starts a new empty conversation.

name: Visitors can use DAVImth chat without signing in
description: Verifies a signed-out visitor can receive a chat response while server-side usage protection remains in place.
steps: Open DAVImth AI in a fresh signed-out browser session
Do not sign in
Send a simple question in the main chat
Wait for the assistant response
expected: DAVImth returns a normal answer without requiring sign-in; the visitor remains subject to server-enforced usage limits.

name: Study Buddy teaches, saves and tracks a learner's progress
description: Checks the core Study Buddy learning workflow, multimodal study inputs, saved lessons and learner progress from one account.
steps: Sign in and open AI Study Buddy
Choose Python Programming and Beginner level
Set the topic to Variables and ask the tutor to explain variables
Wait for the tutor reply and confirm the lesson is saved
Refresh and reopen the saved lesson from history
Attach a readable PDF and an image and ask the tutor to explain them
Attach a short MP4 or WebM video and ask what happens in it
Confirm sampled video frames are included in the tutor request
Try a voice recording or voice conversation and allow microphone access
Enter an invalid quiz score greater than the total and confirm validation
Record a valid quiz score of 8 out of 10
Mark the lesson complete and confirm progress updates
Sign out and confirm personal saved lessons are not displayed
expected: The tutor explains at the selected level, readable documents and images are analysed, sampled video keyframes reach the tutor, voice controls provide clear permission feedback, and lesson history plus completion and quiz progress are saved privately to the signed-in account.

name: Administrator uses the premium virtual classroom
description: Verifies the administrator can use the premium classroom and its visual learning tools without a subscription charge or app-level usage limit.
steps: Sign in as the configured DAVImth administrator
Open AI Study Buddy and confirm Administrator all-access is shown
Open Premium AI Classroom
Choose a speaking voice and language and adjust speaking speed
Choose a teacher appearance and create a realistic teacher portrait
Create an AI chart or graphic for the selected topic
Start a classroom lesson and test voice conversation
expected: The administrator can use browser voice choices, language and speed settings, AI-generated teacher and lesson graphics, and a tutor-led whiteboard lesson without app-level rate limits; provider-level capacity limits may still apply.

name: Preserve the other DAVImth workspaces and Autonomous Intelligence
description: Confirms the Study Buddy release preserves the existing business and creative workspaces and the approved autonomous task queue.
steps: Sign in and open Business Hub
Open AI Customer Support and view the saved assistant list
Open Social and Marketing
Open Image Creator and Video Studio
Open Autonomous Intelligence
Create a goal and approve one task
Queue the approved task, confirm Queued, then cancel it
Refresh and confirm the task remains Cancelled
expected: Existing workspaces remain reachable with their saved owner data, and approved autonomy tasks retain their private queue, approval and cancellation protections.
